```{r}
if (!exists("prefix"))            prefix = "peaks10"
if (!exists("model_func_name"))   model_func_name = "deseq2"
if (!exists("model_formula"))     model_formula = "~status"
if (!exists("pval_threshs"))      pval_threshs = c("0.05", "0.01", "0.001")
if (!exists("bed_ewas_filename")) bed_ewas_filename = paste0("ewas4combp_", paste0(gse, "_", prefix, "_", model_func_name, "_", model_formula), ".bed")
prefix3 = paste0(model_func_name, "_", model_formula)
classes_filename = paste0("features_classes_", prefix, ".tsv")
out_filename = paste0("der_classes_", prefix, "_", prefix3, ".tsv")
genes_filename = paste0("features_classes_", prefix, "_genes.tsv")   # nearest RefSeq TSS gene of each feature (03_features_classes.Rmd)
go_filename = paste0("features_classes_", prefix, "_go_bp.tsv")      # GO BP terms of the RefSeq genes (03_features_classes.Rmd)
go_out_filename = paste0("der_go_", prefix, "_", prefix3, ".tsv")
if (!exists("go_thresh")) go_thresh = pval_threshs[1]                 # comb-p seed of the DER used for GO
if (!exists("go_nperm"))  go_nperm = 1000                             # random gene sets of the matched background
rmsk_filename = paste0("features_classes_", prefix, "_rmsk.tsv")      # feature x repeat overlaps with TE age (03_features_classes.Rmd)
rep_out_filename = paste0("der_repeats_", prefix, "_", prefix3, ".tsv")
if (!exists("rep_min_feat")) rep_min_feat = 50                        # min nb of features of a repeat category in a context
```

- prefix="`r prefix`" is used to reference the features (see `features.Rmd`) and the files generated by the pipeline.
- model: `r model_func_name`, `r model_formula`; comb-p seed thresholds: `r paste(pval_threshs, collapse=", ")`.
- Inputs: ``r classes_filename`` (`03_features_classes.Rmd`), ``r bed_ewas_filename`` (`04_da.Rmd`), `dmrcombp_`r prefix`_`r prefix3`_<thresh>.regions-t.bed` (`04_combp.Rmd`), `norm_counts_deseq_`r prefix`.rds` and ``r prefix`_count.txt.summary`` (`03_count.Rmd`), ``r genes_filename`` and ``r go_filename`` (`03_features_classes.Rmd`, for GO).

Vignettes built using following R command:

```
prefix="`r prefix`" ; model_func_name="`r model_func_name`" ; model_formula="`r model_formula`" ; rmarkdown::render("04_der_classes.Rmd", output_file=paste0("04_der_classes_", prefix, "_", model_func_name, "_", model_formula, ".html"))
```

Questions: which feature classes (RefSeq / GENCODE TSS, lncRNA TSS, cCRE, EpiMap TSS-like and enhancer states, LTR, AluY...) are over- or under-represented in the differential regions (DER), in which direction, and does the direction of the DER follow the per-sample FRiP (signal-to-noise) rather than the status?




# Inputs

```{r inputs, results="verbatim"}
needed = c(classes_filename, bed_ewas_filename, paste0("norm_counts_deseq_", prefix, ".rds"), paste0(prefix, "_count.txt.summary"))
if (!all(file.exists(needed))) {stop(paste0("missing input(s): ", paste(needed[!file.exists(needed)], collapse=", ")))}
# feature classes (03_features_classes.Rmd), features on chr1-22,X,Y outside the blacklist
cl = read.table(classes_filename, header=TRUE, sep="\t", quote="", comment.char="")
rownames(cl) = cl$name
cl$class = factor(cl$class)
lev = levels(cl$class)
# per-feature DA results (04_da.Rmd): position (summit, center or start of the feature), pval, l2fc
ew = read.table(bed_ewas_filename, header=TRUE, sep="\t", comment.char="@")
colnames(ew)[1] = "chrom"
rownames(ew) = ew$probes
print(paste0("features in DA: ", nrow(ew), ", in classes: ", nrow(cl), ", common: ", length(intersect(rownames(ew), rownames(cl)))))
ew = ew[intersect(rownames(ew), rownames(cl)),]
cl = cl[rownames(ew),]
cl$pos  = ew$start
cl$pval = ew$pval
cl$l2fc = ew$l2fc
# mean normalized count (power covariate)
norm_counts = readRDS(paste0("norm_counts_deseq_", prefix, ".rds"))
cl$lmean = log2(rowMeans(norm_counts[rownames(cl),]) + 1)
# comb-p needs >= 2 probes within --dist 1000 (04_combp.Rmd): features with a neighbour <= 1 kb
cl = cl[order(cl$chrom, cl$pos),]
d_prev = c(Inf, diff(cl$pos))
d_prev[c(TRUE, cl$chrom[-1] != cl$chrom[-nrow(cl)])] = Inf
d_next = c(d_prev[-1], Inf)
cl$neigh = pmin(d_prev, d_next) <= 1000
table(cl$class)
```

The coefficient tested is the first term of `r model_formula` (`resultsNames(dds)[2]`, see `04_da.Rmd`): with `e$status` levels `r paste(levels(e$status), collapse=", ")`, `l2fc > 0` means higher in `r levels(e$status)[2]` than in `r levels(e$status)[1]`.

```{r frip, results="verbatim"}
# per-sample FRiP from the featureCounts summary (as in 03_count.Rmd)
raw_counts_summary = read.table(paste0(prefix, "_count.txt.summary"), header=TRUE, row.names=1)
colnames(raw_counts_summary) = sub(paste0(".*", gse, "\\.([^.]+)_end\\.to\\.end.*"), "\\1", colnames(raw_counts_summary))
frip = unlist(raw_counts_summary["Assigned", e$gsm] / colSums(raw_counts_summary[, e$gsm]))
names(frip) = rownames(e)
e$frip = frip
summary(frip)
```

# DER to features

Each feature (position in ``r bed_ewas_filename``) is assigned to the comb-p region (DER) that contains it.
A DER is "up" when the mean `l2fc` of its features is > 0, and its class is the best-ranked class of its features.

```{r der2feat, results="verbatim"}
der = list()
for (t in pval_threshs) {
  f = paste0("dmrcombp_", prefix, "_", prefix3, "_", t, ".regions-t.bed")
  if (!file.exists(f)) {print(paste0("missing ", f)) ; next}
  r = read.table(f, header=TRUE, comment.char="@")
  if (nrow(r) == 0) {print(paste0(t, ": no DER")) ; next}
  colnames(r)[1] = "chrom"
  r$der = paste0("DER", seq_len(nrow(r)))
  fder = rep(NA, nrow(cl))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(r))) {
    idx = which(cl$chrom == r$chrom[i] & cl$pos >= r$start[i] & cl$pos <= r$end[i])
    fder[idx] = r$der[i]
  }
  inn = !is.na(fder)
  r$n_feat = as.vector(table(factor(fder[inn], levels=r$der)))
  r$l2fc   = as.vector(tapply(cl$l2fc[inn], factor(fder[inn], levels=r$der), mean))
  r$dir    = ifelse(r$l2fc > 0, "up", "down")
  r$class  = lev[as.vector(tapply(as.integer(cl$class[inn]), factor(fder[inn], levels=r$der), min))]
  der[[t]] = list(regions=r, fder=fder)
  print(paste0(t, ": ", nrow(r), " DER, ", sum(r$n_feat>0), " with classified features, ", sum(inn), " features, up: ", sum(r$dir=="up", na.rm=TRUE), ", down: ", sum(r$dir=="down", na.rm=TRUE)))
}
```

# Enrichment of feature classes in DER

For each threshold and each class, features in DER vs. all tested features (Fisher's exact test, one class vs. the others), on two backgrounds:

- `all`: all features with a class;
- `neigh`: features with a neighbour feature <= 1 kb (eligible for a comb-p region with `--region-filter-n 2`).

A logistic model (`in DER ~ class + log2 mean count + neigh`, reference class "none") adjusts for power (features with more reads are more often significant) and for the comb-p eligibility.

```{r enrich, results="verbatim"}
enr = list()
for (t in names(der)) {
  inn = !is.na(der[[t]]$fder)
  for (bg in c("all", "neigh")) {
    b = if (bg == "all") rep(TRUE, nrow(cl)) else cl$neigh
    for (lv in lev) {
      x = cl$class == lv
      ft = fisher.test(table(factor(inn[b], c(FALSE, TRUE)), factor(x[b], c(FALSE, TRUE))))
      enr[[length(enr)+1]] = data.frame(thresh=t, test=paste0("fisher_", bg), class=lv,
        n_der_feat=sum(inn & x & b), pct_der=100*mean(x[inn & b]), pct_bg=100*mean(x[b]),
        OR=unname(ft$estimate), pval=ft$p.value)
    }
  }
  ref = lev[length(lev)]
  d = data.frame(inn=inn, class=relevel(cl$class, ref), lmean=cl$lmean, neigh=cl$neigh)
  m = suppressWarnings(glm(inn ~ class + lmean + neigh, data=d, family=binomial))
  co = summary(m)$coefficients
  co = co[paste0("class", setdiff(lev, ref)), , drop=FALSE]
  enr[[length(enr)+1]] = data.frame(thresh=t, test="glm_adj", class=setdiff(lev, ref),
    n_der_feat=NA, pct_der=NA, pct_bg=NA, OR=exp(co[,1]), pval=co[,4])
}
enr = do.call(rbind, enr)
rownames(enr) = NULL
enr$padj = p.adjust(enr$pval, "BH")
enr_print = enr
enr_print[,c("pct_der", "pct_bg", "OR")] = round(enr_print[,c("pct_der", "pct_bg", "OR")], 2)
enr_print[,c("pval", "padj")] = signif(enr_print[,c("pval", "padj")], 2)
enr_print[enr_print$test=="fisher_all",]
enr_print[enr_print$test=="glm_adj",]
write.table(enr, out_filename, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r enrich_hm, fig.height=5}
layout(matrix(1:2, 1), respect=FALSE)
for (tst in c("fisher_all", "glm_adj")) {
  sub = enr[enr$test == tst,]
  m = tapply(log2(pmax(sub$OR, 1/16)), list(factor(sub$class, levels=rev(lev)), factor(sub$thresh, levels=names(der))), mean)
  m = pmin(pmax(m, -3), 3)
  pa = tapply(sub$padj, list(factor(sub$class, levels=rev(lev)), factor(sub$thresh, levels=names(der))), mean)
  par(mar=c(4, 16, 3, 1))
  image(t(m), x=seq_len(ncol(m)), y=seq_len(nrow(m)), zlim=c(-3, 3), col=colorRampPalette(c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b"))(41), axes=FALSE, xlab="comb-p seed", ylab="", main=paste0(tst, ": log2(OR)"))
  axis(1, seq_len(ncol(m)), colnames(m))
  axis(2, seq_len(nrow(m)), rownames(m), las=2, cex.axis=.7)
  txt = ifelse(is.na(m), "", paste0(round(m, 1), ifelse(pa < .05, "*", "")))
  text(rep(seq_len(ncol(m)), each=nrow(m)), rep(seq_len(nrow(m)), ncol(m)), txt, cex=.7)
}
```

`*`: BH adjusted p-value < 0.05 (over all tests of the table). log2(OR) are bounded to [-3, 3].

```{r feat_pval, results="verbatim"}
# independent of comb-p: % of features with DESeq2 p < 0.01 per class
round(100 * tapply(cl$pval < 0.01, cl$class, mean, na.rm=TRUE), 2)
round(100 * mean(cl$pval < 0.01, na.rm=TRUE), 2)
```

# Control: DER direction vs. FRiP

If the DER reflect a difference of signal-to-noise between groups (FRiP), the `l2fc` of a feature follows its association with the per-sample FRiP:
strong TSS features gain and weak distal features lose signal in samples with a high FRiP.
Here, for each feature, Spearman's correlation between its normalized counts and the per-sample FRiP is compared with its `l2fc`.

```{r frip_ctrl, fig.height=4.5, results="verbatim"}
l = log2(norm_counts[rownames(cl), names(frip)] + 1)
cl$rho_frip = suppressWarnings(apply(l, 1, function(v) cor(v, frip, method="spearman")))
print(paste0("cor(l2fc, rho_frip), all features: ", round(cor(cl$l2fc, cl$rho_frip, method="spearman", use="complete"), 3)))
round(tapply(cl$rho_frip, cl$class, median, na.rm=TRUE), 3)
frip_tab = do.call(rbind, lapply(names(der), function(t) {
  inn = !is.na(der[[t]]$fder)
  data.frame(thresh=t, n_feat=sum(inn), pct_same_sign=round(100*mean(sign(cl$l2fc[inn]) == sign(cl$rho_frip[inn]), na.rm=TRUE), 1),
    rho=round(cor(cl$l2fc[inn], cl$rho_frip[inn], method="spearman", use="complete"), 3))
}))
frip_tab
layout(matrix(1:3, 1), respect=TRUE)
for (t in names(der)) {
  inn = !is.na(der[[t]]$fder)
  plot(cl$rho_frip[inn], cl$l2fc[inn], pch=16, cex=.5, col=adjustcolor(cols[as.character(cl$class[inn])], .6),
    xlab="rho(norm. counts, FRiP)", ylab="l2fc", main=paste0("seed ", t, ": DER features"))
  abline(h=0, v=0, lty=2, col="grey")
}
for (v in intersect(c("status", "study", "experimenter"), colnames(e))) {
  print(v)
  print(round(tapply(e$frip, e[[v]], median), 3))
}
if (all(c("status", "experimenter") %in% colnames(e))) {
  print(round(tapply(e$frip, list(e$status, e$experimenter), median), 3))
}
```

# GO enrichment of the DER genes

DER of seed `r go_thresh`: features of up and down DER, at the TSS (<= 1 kb from a RefSeq TSS: gene of this TSS) or distal (5 to 100 kb: nearest gene), from ``r genes_filename`` and ``r go_filename`` (`03_features_classes.Rmd`).
A gene is in the set when one of its features is in a DER of this direction.
GO BP terms of 15 to 500 genes of the universe, two backgrounds:

- `all`: all genes with a tested feature of the same kind (TSS or distal), hypergeometric test;
- `matched`: `r go_nperm` random gene sets with the same number of genes per bin of mean signal x correlation with FRiP (deciles of the strongest feature of each gene), empirical p-value (>= 1 / (`r go_nperm` + 1)).

The genes of the universe are not the whole genome: genes with a sperm H3K4me3 peak are already enriched in housekeeping, cilium and spermatid functions (see `03_features_classes.Rmd`).

```{r go_der, results="verbatim"}
go_tab = NULL
if (!all(file.exists(c(genes_filename, go_filename)))) {
  print(paste0("missing ", genes_filename, " or ", go_filename, " (03_features_classes.Rmd): GO enrichment skipped"))
} else if (!go_thresh %in% names(der)) {
  print(paste0("no DER at seed ", go_thresh, ": GO enrichment skipped"))
} else {
  set.seed(1)
  fg = read.table(genes_filename, header=TRUE, sep="\t", quote="", comment.char="")
  ga = read.table(go_filename, header=TRUE, sep="\t", quote="", comment.char="")
  cl$gene = fg$gene[match(rownames(cl), fg$name)]
  cl$dist_gene = fg$dist_gene[match(rownames(cl), fg$name)]
  fder = der[[go_thresh]]$fder
  r = der[[go_thresh]]$regions
  cl$dir = r$dir[match(fder, r$der)]
  go_run = function(f, label) {
    # gene level: strongest feature of each gene (lmean, rho_frip), in set if any feature in set
    f = f[order(-f$lmean), ]
    g = data.frame(gene = unique(f$gene))
    g$lmean = f$lmean[match(g$gene, f$gene)]
    g$rho_frip = f$rho_frip[match(g$gene, f$gene)]
    g$in_set = g$gene %in% f$gene[f$in_set]
    g = g[g$gene %in% ga$gene, ]
    if (sum(g$in_set) < 10) {print(paste0(label, ": ", sum(g$in_set), " genes in GO, skipped")); return(NULL)}
    gs = split(ga$gene[ga$gene %in% g$gene], ga$go[ga$gene %in% g$gene])
    gs = gs[lengths(gs) >= 15 & lengths(gs) <= 500]
    M = sapply(gs, function(x) g$gene %in% x)
    obs = colSums(M[g$in_set, , drop=FALSE])
    n = sum(g$in_set); N = nrow(g); m = colSums(M)
    p_all = phyper(obs - 1, m, N - m, n, lower.tail=FALSE)
    bin = paste(cut(g$lmean, unique(quantile(g$lmean, 0:10/10)), include.lowest=TRUE), cut(g$rho_frip, unique(quantile(g$rho_frip, 0:10/10)), include.lowest=TRUE))
    nb = table(bin[g$in_set])
    idx = split(seq_len(N), bin)
    perm = sapply(seq_len(go_nperm), function(i) {
      s = unlist(lapply(names(nb), function(b) {ii = idx[[b]]; ii[sample.int(length(ii), nb[[b]])]}))
      colSums(M[s, , drop=FALSE])
    })
    p_matched = (rowSums(perm >= obs) + 1) / (go_nperm + 1)
    res = data.frame(set = label, go = names(gs), term = ga$term[match(names(gs), ga$go)], size = m, obs = obs,
      exp_all = round(n * m / N, 1), exp_matched = round(rowMeans(perm), 1), p_all = p_all, padj_all = p.adjust(p_all, "BH"),
      p_matched = p_matched, padj_matched = p.adjust(p_matched, "BH"))
    print(paste0(label, ": ", n, " genes / ", N, ", ", length(gs), " terms, padj_all < 0.05: ", sum(res$padj_all < .05), ", padj_matched < 0.05: ", sum(res$padj_matched < .05)))
    top = res[order(res$p_all), ][1:10, c("term", "size", "obs", "exp_all", "exp_matched", "padj_all", "p_matched", "padj_matched")]
    top$term = substr(top$term, 1, 55)
    top[, c("padj_all", "p_matched", "padj_matched")] = signif(top[, c("padj_all", "p_matched", "padj_matched")], 2)
    print(top, row.names=FALSE)
    res
  }
  ok = !is.na(cl$gene) & !is.na(cl$rho_frip)
  go_tab = list()
  for (d in c("up", "down")) {
    for (w in c("TSS", "distal")) {
      f = cl[ok & (if (w == "TSS") cl$dist_gene <= 1000 else cl$dist_gene > 5000 & cl$dist_gene <= 1e5), c("gene", "lmean", "rho_frip", "dir")]
      f$in_set = !is.na(f$dir) & f$dir == d
      go_tab[[paste(d, w)]] = go_run(f, paste0(d, " DER, ", w))
    }
  }
  go_tab = do.call(rbind, go_tab)
  if (!is.null(go_tab)) {
    rownames(go_tab) = NULL
    go_tab$thresh = go_thresh
    write.table(go_tab, go_out_filename, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
  }
}
if (is.null(go_tab)) {write.table(data.frame(set=character(0)), go_out_filename, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)}
```

# Repeats of the DER

DER of seed `r go_thresh`. Unlike the hierarchical classes above (a TE under a TSS is counted as TSS), each feature is flagged with all the repeats it overlaps (>= 1 bp, ``r rmsk_filename``, `03_features_classes.Rmd`), at three levels:

- repeat class (SINE, LINE, LTR, DNA, Retroposon/SVA, Satellite, Simple_repeat, Low_complexity);
- TE class x age group (divergence from the consensus: `<=5%` young, `5-10%`, `10-20%`, `>20%` old);
- TE family x age group for Alu, L1, ERV1, ERVK, ERVL, ERVL-MaLR and SVA.

For each category, direction (up, down) and context (all features, TSS: <= 1 kb from a RefSeq TSS, distal: > 5 kb), features in a DER of this direction are compared with the other tested features:
Fisher's exact test (`OR`), and logistic regression adjusted for the mean signal, the correlation with FRiP and the comb-p eligibility (`in DER ~ category + lmean + rho_frip + neigh`, `OR_adj`), the adjustment that removes the global TSS/distal shift.
Categories with < `r rep_min_feat` features in the context are not tested.
Young copies are poorly mappable (multi-mapped reads are filtered out): their features have fewer reads, which the adjustment on the mean signal only partly accounts for.

```{r rep_der, results="verbatim"}
rep_tab = NULL
if (!file.exists(rmsk_filename)) {
  print(paste0("missing ", rmsk_filename, " (03_features_classes.Rmd): repeats skipped"))
} else if (!go_thresh %in% names(der)) {
  print(paste0("no DER at seed ", go_thresh, ": repeats skipped"))
} else {
  ro = read.table(rmsk_filename, header=TRUE, sep="\t", quote="", comment.char="")
  ro = ro[ro$name %in% rownames(cl), ]
  ro$class_age = ifelse(is.na(ro$age), NA, paste(ro$class, ro$age))
  ro$family_age = ifelse(is.na(ro$age) | !ro$family %in% c("Alu", "L1", "ERV1", "ERVK", "ERVL", "ERVL-MaLR", "SVA"), NA, paste(ro$family, ro$age))
  age_levels = c("<=5%", "5-10%", "10-20%", ">20%")
  cats = c(
    paste0("class: ", intersect(c("SINE", "LINE", "LTR", "DNA", "Retroposon", "Satellite", "Simple_repeat", "Low_complexity"), ro$class)),
    paste0("TE age: ", as.vector(t(outer(c("SINE", "LINE", "LTR", "DNA", "Retroposon"), age_levels, paste)))),
    paste0("family age: ", as.vector(t(outer(c("Alu", "L1", "ERV1", "ERVK", "ERVL", "ERVL-MaLR", "SVA"), age_levels, paste))))
  )
  flag = sapply(cats, function(k) {
    lvl = sub("^[^:]+: ", "", k)
    col = c("class" = "class", "TE age" = "class_age", "family age" = "family_age")[sub(":.*", "", k)]
    rownames(cl) %in% ro$name[ro[[col]] %in% lvl]
  })
  fder = der[[go_thresh]]$fder
  r = der[[go_thresh]]$regions
  dir = r$dir[match(fder, r$der)]
  ok = !is.na(cl$rho_frip)
  ctx = list(all = ok, TSS = ok & cl$dist_tss <= 1000, distal = ok & cl$dist_tss > 5000)
  rep_tab = list()
  for (d in c("up", "down")) {
    y = !is.na(dir) & dir == d
    for (cn in names(ctx)) {
      b = ctx[[cn]]
      if (sum(y[b]) < 10) next
      for (k in cats) {
        x = flag[, k]
        if (sum(x[b]) < rep_min_feat) next
        ft = fisher.test(table(factor(y[b], c(FALSE, TRUE)), factor(x[b], c(FALSE, TRUE))))
        dd = data.frame(y = y[b], x = x[b], lmean = cl$lmean[b], rho_frip = cl$rho_frip[b], neigh = cl$neigh[b])
        co = summary(suppressWarnings(glm(y ~ x + lmean + rho_frip + neigh, data=dd, family=binomial)))$coefficients
        rep_tab[[length(rep_tab) + 1]] = data.frame(thresh = go_thresh, dir = d, context = cn, category = k,
          n_feat = sum(x[b]), n_der = sum(x[b] & y[b]), pct_der = 100 * mean(x[b & y]), pct_bg = 100 * mean(x[b]),
          OR = unname(ft$estimate), pval = ft$p.value,
          OR_adj = if ("xTRUE" %in% rownames(co)) exp(co["xTRUE", 1]) else NA, pval_adj = if ("xTRUE" %in% rownames(co)) co["xTRUE", 4] else NA)
      }
    }
  }
  rep_tab = do.call(rbind, rep_tab)
  rep_tab$padj = p.adjust(rep_tab$pval, "BH")
  rep_tab$padj_adj = p.adjust(rep_tab$pval_adj, "BH")
  write.table(rep_tab, rep_out_filename, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
  pr = rep_tab
  pr[, c("pct_der", "pct_bg", "OR", "OR_adj")] = round(pr[, c("pct_der", "pct_bg", "OR", "OR_adj")], 2)
  pr[, c("padj", "padj_adj")] = signif(pr[, c("padj", "padj_adj")], 2)
  print(pr[pr$padj_adj < 0.05, c("dir", "context", "category", "n_feat", "n_der", "pct_der", "pct_bg", "OR", "padj", "OR_adj", "padj_adj")], row.names=FALSE)
}
if (is.null(rep_tab)) {write.table(data.frame(category=character(0)), rep_out_filename, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)}
```

```{r rep_der_hm, fig.height=9}
if (!is.null(rep_tab)) {
  rep_tab$col = paste(rep_tab$dir, rep_tab$context)
  cols_order = intersect(paste(rep(c("up", "down"), each=3), c("all", "TSS", "distal")), unique(rep_tab$col))
  m = tapply(log2(rep_tab$OR_adj), list(factor(rep_tab$category, levels=rev(cats)), factor(rep_tab$col, levels=cols_order)), mean)
  pa = tapply(rep_tab$padj_adj, list(factor(rep_tab$category, levels=rev(cats)), factor(rep_tab$col, levels=cols_order)), mean)
  m = m[rowSums(!is.na(m)) > 0, , drop=FALSE]; pa = pa[rownames(m), , drop=FALSE]
  ml = pmin(pmax(m, -3), 3)
  layout(1, respect=TRUE)
  par(mar=c(6, 14, 3, 1))
  image(t(ml), x=seq_len(ncol(m)), y=seq_len(nrow(m)), zlim=c(-3, 3), col=colorRampPalette(c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b"))(41), axes=FALSE, xlab="", ylab="", main="repeats in DER: adjusted log2(OR)")
  axis(1, seq_len(ncol(m)), colnames(m), las=2, cex.axis=.8)
  axis(2, seq_len(nrow(m)), rownames(m), las=2, cex.axis=.6)
  txt = ifelse(is.na(m), "", paste0(round(m, 1), ifelse(pa < .05, "*", "")))
  text(rep(seq_len(ncol(m)), each=nrow(m)), rep(seq_len(nrow(m)), ncol(m)), txt, cex=.55)
}
```

`*`: BH adjusted p-value of the adjusted model < 0.05; grey: not tested (< `r rep_min_feat` features or < 10 DER features in the context).

# Material and Methods

Differential regions (DER) were obtained with comb-p (seed thresholds `r paste(pval_threshs, collapse=", ")`, `--dist 1000`, `--region-filter-p 0.05 --region-filter-n 2`) from the per-feature `r model_func_name` p-values (`r model_formula`, features `prefix` = `r prefix`).
Each feature was assigned to the DER containing its position, and features were annotated with the hierarchical classes of `03_features_classes.Rmd` (RefSeq and GENCODE TSS, lncRNA TSS, ENCODE cCRE v3, EpiMap TSS-like and enhancer states in testis and ESC, ERV1 LTR/SVA and AluY repeats).
For each threshold and class, features in DER were compared with all tested features (Fisher's exact test), with features having a neighbour within 1 kb (comb-p eligibility), and with a logistic regression adjusted for the log2 mean normalized count and the comb-p eligibility; p-values were adjusted with Benjamini-Hochberg.
As a control of signal-to-noise effects, the per-sample fraction of fragments in features (FRiP, `featureCounts` summary) was correlated (Spearman) with the normalized counts of each feature and compared with the feature log2 fold change.
For GO enrichment, features of up and down DER (seed `r go_thresh`) were linked to the gene of their RefSeq TSS (<= 1 kb) or to their nearest gene (distal features, 5 to 100 kb), and GO Biological Process terms of 15 to 500 genes (`org.Hs.eg.db`, including descendant terms) were tested against all genes with a tested feature of the same kind (hypergeometric test) and against `r go_nperm` random gene sets matched on mean signal and correlation with FRiP (empirical p-values); p-values were adjusted with Benjamini-Hochberg.
For repeats, each feature was flagged with all the RepeatMasker copies it overlaps, by repeat class, TE class x age group and TE family x age group (age: divergence from the consensus, <= 5%, 5-10%, 10-20%, > 20%); for each direction of DER and context (all, <= 1 kb, > 5 kb from a RefSeq TSS), features in DER were compared with the other tested features (Fisher's exact test, and logistic regression adjusted for the mean signal, the correlation with FRiP and the comb-p eligibility), with Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment.
Results are in ``r out_filename``, ``r go_out_filename`` and ``r rep_out_filename``.
